title: Research on Rice Yield Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning
summary: Original source reports a concrete field-yield prediction result from measured rice plots using learned regression over rice-ear image and seed traits. The title overstates deep learning: the decisive model is regression, not a demonstrated deep network. The result is a bounded retrospective plot prediction, not a general yield claim. Methods: 207 paddy plots; 179 effective plot records; ear-area imagery and seed traits used as predictors for measured plot yield. Linear/nonlinear regression evaluates the relationship; OPCA power model R²=0.513 and multi-feature adjusted R²=0.456. Field-specific measured outcome supports eligibility, with limited cohort and data-on-request caveats.
